keywords.title: Keywords
keywords.description: Search terms to analyze. Each keyword is queried on its own (absolute 0-100 scale per keyword) unless *Compare keywords* is on.

compareKeywords.title: Compare keywords
compareKeywords.description: Compare keywords against each other like the Trends UI (groups of up to 5 share one 0-100 scale). Off = each keyword is scored independently.

geo.title: Location
geo.description: Country code (`US`, `GB`, `DE`, `KR`...), region (`US-CA`) or empty for worldwide.

timeframe.title: Timeframe
timeframe.description: Google Trends time range: `now 1-H`, `now 4-H`, `now 1-d`, `now 7-d`, `today 1-m`, `today 3-m`, `today 12-m`, `today 5-y`, `all`, or a date range `2025-01-01 2025-06-30`.

category.title: Category ID
category.description: Google Trends category ID (0 = all categories). Find IDs in the URL of trends.google.com after choosing a category, e.g. 31 = Programming.

includeInterestOverTime.title: Interest over time
includeInterestOverTime.description: One row per date with the 0-100 interest value.

includeInterestByRegion.title: Interest by region
includeInterestByRegion.description: One row per region/city with its 0-100 value.

regionResolution.title: Region resolution
regionResolution.description: Granularity of *Interest by region*. COUNTRY only works when Location is empty (worldwide).

includeLowVolumeRegions.title: Include low-volume regions
includeLowVolumeRegions.description: Also return regions with very little search volume.

includeRelatedQueries.title: Related queries
includeRelatedQueries.description: Top and rising related searches (25 each).

includeRelatedTopics.title: Related topics
includeRelatedTopics.description: Top and rising related topics. Note: Google returns these only for signed-in sessions, so this is often empty.

includeSuggestions.title: Autocomplete topics
includeSuggestions.description: Google's entity suggestions for each keyword (mid, title, type).

trendingNow.title: Trending Now list
trendingNow.description: Also scrape the live *Trending now* list (no keywords needed).

trendingHours.title: Trending window (hours)
trendingHours.description: Time window for Trending Now in hours: 4, 24, 48 or 168.

trendingActiveOnly.title: Only active trends
trendingActiveOnly.description: Skip trends that have already ended.

language.title: Language
language.description: UI language for names and categories, e.g. `en-US`, `ko`, `de`.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: Google Trends rate-limits IPs aggressively. Apify Proxy is enabled by default; keep it on.
